column1: # THE SHIPPING RECIPE CATALOG, AND IT IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY.
# strawberry 2026-09-06: "can you clear all the current crafting recipes we have in the crafting ui" /
# "completely empty crafting list". The 1875 extracted retail rows are NOT deleted -- they live beside this
# file as blueprints.retail.tsv, which the index/filter/search tests load explicitly as their fixture. So the
# filter logic stays covered while the game ships nothing, and re-adding a recipe means appending a row here.
# Format (tab-separated, 8 columns): owner  operation  name  skill  level  inputs  outputs  stations
# FromTsv skips any line with fewer than 8 tabs, which is why these comments cost nothing.
